plan.notes: Official 'Major Map' (recommended course sequence) from the University of South Carolina 2026-2027 bulletin. All 8 semesters transcribed verbatim; row sums match declared term totals (16/16/17/15/15/15/14/12); Minimum Total Hours 120. Ranged slots transcribed at values fitting the plan's totals: MATH 122/141 at 4cr, MATH 142/170/172/174 and Semester Five Carolina Core at 3cr. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
